angle.hook: a game based on the Unicorn Academy TV series launches in two days on PS5, Xbox, Switch and Steam
angle.why_now: the Steam page and the publisher's trailer both show 17 November 2026 and Xbox Wire lists it in next week's releases (13 Nov), so the launch is Tuesday
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf families can pick it up on every major console and Steam, but Steam lists no Arabic and no price yet
angle.payoff: the 17 November card with the platforms, then the villain and the academy closing shot
